reason: Initial 7460-case math baseline from live native run 45380617555, after the full object-mode gate, installed GCC13.3/glibc2.39 closure, reviewed matrix context and exact generated NaN-site emission passed on this same oracle. Debug/release live equality and refusal checks precede blessing. The selected reference uses baseline SSE2 libm dispatch and the measured libstdc++ stream behavior. All 3501 mixed-NaN cases and ten dispatch-sensitive angles remain; complete output is pinned to SHA256 5b3e42d65eb6b6126acbbf5d45cfbdcc27d461c25558179a84aa0b1c5dd4525b. The unchanged runner rechecks live equality, binary hashes and provenance during blessing. No tolerance, defined-input exclusion or fabricated output. This is a scoped partial-unit baseline, not universal reference adoption, other-locale/rounding-mode or second-host qualification.
